title: RideIntel Cleaning and Quality Reason Codes
description: Standardized reason codes, precedence rules, and quality flags for raw taxi trip data ingestion and quality auditing.

categories.PRIMARY_EXCLUSION: Record dropped from the pipeline. Assigned strictly by evaluation precedence (rank 1 to 6) so each excluded record has exactly one primary reason.
categories.QUALITY_FLAG: Informational flag attached to retained records. Non-exclusionary; does not affect demand counting and must never be counted in the exclusion reconciliation equation.

precedence_rules: When a record fails multiple validation criteria, the primary exclusion code with the lowest rank number is assigned. Only one primary exclusion is recorded per dropped record.

EXCLUDE_INVALID_JSON.description: Malformed JSON line that could not be parsed.

EXCLUDE_MISSING_TRIP_ID.description: Missing, null, or blank trip_id; deterministic event_id cannot be constructed.

EXCLUDE_DUPLICATE_TRIP_ID.description: Subsequent occurrence of an already-processed trip_id within the deduplication scope.

EXCLUDE_INVALID_OR_MISSING_TIMESTAMP.description: Missing or unparseable trip_start_timestamp; cannot assign to a temporal demand window.

EXCLUDE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS_TIMESTAMP.description: trip_start_timestamp falls outside the configured half-open target interval [2022-06-01T00:00:00, 2022-07-01T00:00:00) America/Chicago.

EXCLUDE_NO_SPATIAL_REFERENCE.description: Both pickup coordinates (latitude, longitude) and pickup_community_area are missing or null. Trip originated outside Chicago or was suppressed.

FLAG_COMMUNITY_AREA_MISSING_COORDS_PRESE.description: Pickup coordinates are valid and mapped to H3, but pickup_community_area is null (peripheral/boundary tract). Eligible for H3 demand; excluded from community area rollups.

FLAG_COORDS_MISSING_COMMUNITY_PRESENT.description: Pickup coordinates are null, but pickup_community_area is valid. Eligible for community-area rollups; excluded from H3 gridded demand.

FLAG_NON_POSITIVE_MILES.description: trip_miles <= 0.0 or missing. Counted in pickup demand; excluded from speed and distance analytics.

FLAG_NON_POSITIVE_SECONDS.description: trip_seconds <= 0 or missing. Counted in pickup demand; excluded from duration and speed analytics.

FLAG_ZERO_OR_MISSING_FARE.description: fare <= 0.0 or missing. Counted in pickup demand; excluded from revenue analytics.

FLAG_ZERO_OR_MISSING_TIPS.description: tips <= 0.0 or missing. Counted in pickup demand; reflects cash tip omission or zero tip.
